title: New law: An original joint resolution to amend section 1319 of the Housing and Urban Development Act of 1968 to increase the limitation on the face amount of flood insurance coverage authorized to be outstanding. (Public Law 93-4)
summary: S.J.Res. 26 of the 93rd Congress became Public Law 93-4 on 1973-02-02.

title: New law: An original joint resolution to extend the life of the Commission on Highway Beautification established under section 123 of the Federal-Aid Highway Act of 1970. (Public Law 93-6)
summary: S.J.Res. 42 of the 93rd Congress became Public Law 93-6 on 1973-02-16.

title: New law: A joint resolution to designate the Manned Space Craft Center in Houston, Tex., as the "Lyndon B. Johnson Space Center" in honor of the late President. (Public Law 93-8)
summary: S.J.Res. 37 of the 93rd Congress became Public Law 93-8 on 1973-02-17.

title: New law: Joint resolution to extend the provisions of the Railway Labor Act, and for other purposes. (Public Law 93-5)
summary: S.J.Res. 59 of the 93rd Congress became Public Law 93-5 on 1973-02-09.

title: New law: A joint resolution relating to the date for the submission of the report of the Joint Economic Committee on the President's Economic Report. (Public Law 93-7)
summary: H.J.Res. 299 of the 93rd Congress became Public Law 93-7 on 1973-02-16.

title: New law: A joint resolution providing for a moment of Prayer and Thanksgiving and a National Day of Prayer and Thanksgiving. (Public Law 93-3)
summary: H.J.Res. 246 of the 93rd Congress became Public Law 93-3 on 1973-02-01.
